feature_meanings.log_career_starts: log1p(completed starts before this date, any series)
feature_meanings.career_win_rate: career win rate shrunk toward the as-of series mean (5 pseudo-starts)
feature_meanings.career_avg_finish: career average finishing position, shrunk toward the series mean
feature_meanings.last5_avg_finish: average finish over the previous 5 starts
feature_meanings.last10_avg_finish: average finish over the previous 10 starts
feature_meanings.last5_win_rate: win rate over the previous 5 starts
feature_meanings.last10_win_rate: win rate over the previous 10 starts
feature_meanings.ewm_finish: exponentially weighted average finish, half-life 10 starts
feature_meanings.ewm_win: exponentially weighted win indicator, half-life 10 starts
feature_meanings.log_days_since_last_start: log1p(days since the driver's previous completed start)
feature_meanings.won_last_14d: 1 if the driver won a race in the previous 14 days
feature_meanings.podium_last_14d: 1 if the driver finished top-3 in the previous 14 days
feature_meanings.track_win_rate: win rate at this track, shrunk toward the career rate
feature_meanings.track_top3_rate: top-3 rate at this track, shrunk
feature_meanings.track_avg_finish: average finish at this track, shrunk toward the career average
feature_meanings.log_similar_track_starts: log1p(similarity-weighted prior starts at tracks listed in track_similars)
feature_meanings.similar_track_win_rate: similarity-weighted win rate at similar tracks, shrunk
feature_meanings.similar_track_avg_finish: similarity-weighted average finish at similar tracks, shrunk
feature_meanings.prev_same_track_3d: 1 if the driver raced at this track in the previous 1-3 days (multi-night event)
feature_meanings.prev_same_track_win_3d: 1 if the driver won at this track in the previous 1-3 days
feature_meanings.prev_same_track_top3_3d: 1 if the driver finished top-3 at this track in the previous 1-3 days
feature_meanings.prev_same_track_finish_3d: finishing position at this track in the previous 1-3 days (NaN if none)
feature_meanings.crown_prior_podium_365d: 1 if top-3 at a crown-jewel event in the previous 365 days
feature_meanings.crown_prior_win_365d: 1 if won a crown-jewel event in the previous 365 days
feature_meanings.eldora_prior_podium_365d: 1 if top-3 at Eldora in the previous 365 days
feature_meanings.elo: pairwise finishing-order Elo rating before this date (K=24, start 1500)
feature_meanings.elo_field_rel: Elo minus the mean Elo of tonight's field
feature_meanings.field_size: number of entrants scored in this race

model_algorithm: XGBoost binary score (depth 3, 300 trees, eta 0.03) with per-race temperature softmax
trained_on: DIRTcar Summer Nationals through 2026-06-19 (99 races, 2241 entries)
